verdict.rationale: Evidence only mentions 'Isaac TeleOp' in passing as a data-ingestion source for converting real-world captures into USD (nvidia-isaac-docs-15), with no documentation of live video streaming, network-resilient control, or remote operator interfaces. The rest of the pack focuses on simulation, synthetic data, ROS 2 validation, and policy training, not real-time teleoperation over real-world networks. Missing for 10: any documented live video/control-loop architecture, latency/network-resilience handling, or hands-on teleoperation demo evidence.
